HeroSection.name: Shayan Noori
HeroSection.introduction: I am a front-end developer specializing in JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js and Next.js, and I bring fast, responsive, and search engine optimized websites to life.

SkillsSection.hiddenText: no more cards for you, but dont worry, more cards are coming!

ExpSection.tradingDescription: As a Front-end Developer at TradingUnique, I built internal dashboard pages using React.js to modernize an existing Laravel project. I integrated React via Vite’s plugin to replace Blade-rendered views for faster and more dynamic UI performance. I implemented user-facing forms with React Hook Form and data tables with TanStack Table to improve validation and interactivity. I structured the frontend architecture with modular logic and a clean folder structure to ensure long-term scalability and ease of maintenance. I also documented the codebase and wrote comprehensive unit tests using Vitest and React Testing Library to support future development and onboarding.
ExpSection.apancoDescription: As a Front-end Developer at Apanco, I built a web app with React.js to manage teachers, students, and courses. I integrated over 150 RESTful APIs using TanStack Query for smoother data handling and built a scalable front-end architecture for easier maintenance. I worked closely with design and back-end teams to deliver polished UI updates and resolved a memory leak that improved app stability. Agile collaboration helped us ship features more efficiently.
ExpSection.sepehrDescription: As a React JS Developer at Sepehregan Academy, I developed a beginner-friendly monitoring web app using React.js, focusing on reusable components to improve efficiency and reduce code duplication. I optimized performance by leveraging Context API and TanStack Query, decreasing latency on low-end devices. I collaborated with designers to build responsive interfaces using Tailwind CSS and created an engaging admin panel with Vuexy admin panel template and React-strap, which lead to increased user interaction.
